info.title: zer0-CMS platform API
info.description: Agent runs, the content graph, suggestions and the tool registry; and for the studio and the extension, the session, sites, pages, revisions, publishing and the review inbox. Wagtail's pages, images and documents endpoints live beside these at /api/v2/ and are documented by Wagtail.

ids.description: The run's pending suggestions the caller saw and accepts — only these, never the rest of the run.

id.description: Absent on a block that is new in this request.

stale.description: The block it aims at is gone; accepting it would be refused.

field.description: The field at fault, or null for the whole request.

FieldKindEnum.description:
* `text` - text
* `textarea` - textarea
* `datetime` - datetime
* `integer` - integer
* `choice` - choice
* `multichoice` - multichoice
* `tags` - tags

csrf_token.description: Send it as `X-CSRFToken` on every unsafe request.

type.description: One of the parent's creatable types, e.g. `cms.ArticlePage`.

children.description: How many pages sit directly under it.

markdown.description: The body as Markdown, as the exporter writes it.

lock.description: Why the caller cannot change the page now — a Wagtail lock: another person's, a workflow task's, or a scheduled publish's (cancelling the schedule lifts it) — or null.

preview_url.description: The latest revision rendered by the platform.

children.description: How many pages sit directly under it.

base_revision_id.description: The revision edited (null only for a page without one); a newer one makes the save a 409.

Run.description: What `api.views.run_json` returns; `steps` only on a single run.

is_final.description: It has finished (succeeded, failed, refused or cancelled).

go_live_at.description: When the latest revision goes live; leave it out to publish now.

expire_at.description: When the page comes down again. Give one of the two, or both.

agentToken.description: An agent token (`manage.py agent_token <slug> --name …`); the caller acts as that agent user.
